name: Windmill
description: Open-source developer platform to turn scripts into workflows, webhooks, cron jobs, and internal UIs. Run Python, TypeScript, Go, Bash, and SQL with a built-in editor and orchestration engine. The first user to sign up becomes the superadmin; if not created during setup, log in with admin@windmill.dev / changeme and change the password immediately.

env.label: Database Password
env.description: Password for the internal PostgreSQL database. The DATABASE_URL is composed from this automatically.

env.label: Base URL
env.description: External URL Windmill is served at (e.g. https://windmill.example.com). Used for generating links and webhooks.
